2609.09752.title: HiRAD: A Flexible Large-Scale AGV Routing System
2609.09752.paper_summary: Automatic Guided Vehicles (AGVs) substantially boost warehouse throughput, but routing large-scale AGV fleets remains challenging. Classical Multi-Agent Pathfinding solvers suffer from exploding combinatorial complexity and super-quadratic runtime, while relying on idealized grid or piecewise-linear motion models that mismatch real-world kinematics. Recent Reinforcement Learning (RL) solutions improve flexibility via decentralized agent policies but depend on discretized spatiotemporal representations, require millions of episodes to converge, and incur full-map observation at every step, which leads to large models, slow convergence, and high inference latency that violates real-time industrial control constraints. To address these bottlenecks, we propose HiRAD, a hierarchical RL framework for continuous-space AGV routing with real-time guarantees: (1) a step-level spatiotemporal representation that translates continuous motion into a differentiable RL problem, (2) a hierarchical strategy that splits heading choice from velocity control to reduce the action space, and (3) an asynchronous event-driven decision pipeline that lowers inference complexity from O(n^2) to O(n) and cuts per-step latency by as much as 71 percent. Across random graphs and two warehouse maps, HiRAD reduces makespan by 45 percent to 63 percent and shortens end-to-end runtime.
2609.09752.paper_summary_zh: 自動引導車輛（AGVs）顯著提升倉庫的吞吐量，但路由大規模AGV車隊仍然面臨挑戰。傳統的多智能體路徑尋找求解器遭受爆炸性的組合複雜性和超二次的運行時間，同時依賴理想化的網格或分段線性運動模型，這些模型與現實世界的運動學不匹配。最近的增強學習（RL）解決方案通過去中心化的智能體策略提高了靈活性，但依賴於離散的時空表示，需要數百萬次的訓練回合才能收斂，並在每一步都需要全圖觀察，這導致了大型模型、緩慢的收斂速度和高推理延遲，違反了實時工業控制的約束。為了解決這些瓶頸，我們提出了HiRAD，一個具有實時保證的連續空間AGV路由的分層RL框架：（1）一個步驟級的時空表示，將連續運動轉換為可微分的RL問題，（2）一個分層策略，將航向選擇與速度控制分開，以減少行動空間，以及（3）一個異步事件驅動的決策管道，將推理複雜性從O(n^2)降低到O(n)，並將每步延遲減少多達71%。在隨機圖和兩個倉庫地圖上，HiRAD將完工時間減少了45%至63%，並縮短了端到端的運行時間。
